recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes a directly related narrative typo without broadening the Jira resolution; do not add CarePlan.activity.linkId absent a separate work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-20570 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution to add optional string linkId elements to PlanDefinition.action and RequestGroup.action for R5, avoiding use of Element.id as the primary cross-action linkage mechanism.
initial_application: Commit fc2803f516 added the requested PlanDefinition.action.linkId and RequestGroup.action.linkId elements. FHIR-24619 later renamed RequestGroup to RequestOrchestration while preserving action.linkId. FHIR-33169 later updated the PlanDefinition $apply narrative to refer to linkId, but introduced the stray linkId> token in that narrative.
additional_context: The active current build uses PlanDefinition and RequestOrchestration resources, with RequestGroup mapped to RequestOrchestration in fhir.ini. Current CarePlan.activity has no linkId element, matching the final resolution scope, which named only PlanDefinition.action and RequestGroup.action. The originating Zulip workflow discussion supports the same request, and Confluence searches found no conflicting record.
reconciliation: Changed source/plandefinition/plandefinition-notes.xml to say set the linkId element of the new RequestOrchestration action, replacing the non-existent linkId> element name. No StructureDefinition changes were needed because the requested optional elements are already present.
